verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's primary surface is its official web app. That app carries a broad feature set beyond basic chat, including memory, web search, voice/video calls, channels, RAG and automations. It is also a PWA that can be installed on a phone home screen or desktop taskbar, so the same full feature set reaches desktop and mobile. Missing for 10: native desktop or mobile apps (only a PWA wrapper is evidenced), evidence of how mobile/PWA usability or features hold up in practice, and independent hands-on corroboration of cross-surface parity.
